name: settle_outcome
description: Acknowledge a completed outcome against existing generation reservations. Does not debit credits again. Empty args still refuse plan-page wallet access. Unauthenticated production returns NOT_LIVE.

client_reference.description: Your own order reference (1-200 visible ASCII characters). The same brief from the same account is the same order: executing it again replays the finished result instead of charging again. Send a new client_reference to order the same brief again.

includePilot.description: Include third-party pilot marketplace listings. Default false. Not inferred from an API key.

objective.description: What media must exist when the job is done. Do not name a model.

prefer_authorization.description: How consent is proven, independent of the rail. session is the authenticated API key or OAuth token and is the only live option. ap2_mandate (AP2) and network_token are reserved.

prefer_rail.description: Preferred settlement rail. credits is default. x402 is optional USDC. stripe_account is human Checkout. mpp is Stripe's Machine Payments Protocol (Shared Payment Token, $0.50 minimum); it settles only when the deployment enables it, and the quote's accepted_rails reports whether it is available. card_agent (card-network credentials) is reserved, not implemented.
